name: Latted
long_description:
Latted is an all-in one tool to generate and edit professional AI video projects.

All professional AI video projects take more than a single generation. You need to juggle between hundreds of images and videos and use multiple tools to edit your project.

With Latted, you can generate a 10-minute long video from a single prompt or generate and edit your project from scratch.

Thousands of creators use Latted for marketing videos, content creation and educational content. Create your first project today at latted.com!

launches.title: Latted - Automated Content Engine for Growth
launches.tagline: Generate creatives for paid and organic marketing on autopilot
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're Emre and Metehan, the founders of [Latted](https://latted.com/).

## **TL;DR**

Latted is an AI video studio that covers the whole paid-social creative loop:

* **Explore**: search winning ads across Meta Ad Library, TikTok, Reels and Shorts at once, and get an AI breakdown of why each one works.
* **Composer**: turn a prompt, an attachment, or an ad you found into an **editable** video project, not a one-off clip.
* **Engines**: point one at your brand. Every day it studies your market and competitors, makes new videos with Composer, and has them ready for you to review in the morning.

You can try it free with 5 credits, no card required → [**latted.com**](http://latted.com)

## **The problem**

Making AI video is no longer the hard part. Most teams get stuck everywhere else:

* **Research.** Finding out what works means opening four tabs (Meta Ad Library, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube), scrolling for hours, and keeping notes nobody reads again.
* **Production.** Generators give you a clip. Then you re-prompt from scratch, export to an editor, and lose all your context with every revision.
* **Repetition.** Winning creatives wear out in weeks, so the research and production cycle never ends. Most small teams can't keep up, and big teams keep hiring for it.

The result is fewer tests, slower learning, and ad accounts running last month's creative.

## **Our solution**

We built one workspace where research, production and iteration share the same context. It has three parts.

### **Explore: see what's working, all at once**

Search a brand, a product or a topic (e.g. "AG1" or "skincare routine"), and Explore pulls in paid ads and organic short-form from **Meta Ad Library, TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts in one feed**.

Open any result and Latted watches it frame by frame, then breaks down the hook, the structure and pacing, and _why it works_. When you find one you like, click **Use in Composer** and it becomes the starting point for your own video.

### **Composer: a prompt that ends in an editable project**

Composer is our main agent. You give it a brief plus whatever you have (product screenshots, logos, footage, PDFs, or a reference ad from Explore). It plans the video, generates the scenes, voice and music, and assembles everything into a **real project with scenes, assets and a timeline**.

That project is the point. The first draft is rarely the final one, so instead of re-rolling a clip you keep going. You can message Composer to change the hook, swap the character, localize it into Spanish, or edit the timeline yourself. Your context carries over with every revision.

### **Engines: fresh creatives, every morning**

Engines are what we're most excited about. An Engine is an always-on agent assigned to one brand or product.

Setup takes a few minutes. You paste your website, add the competitors you're up against (it tracks their Meta pages and TikTok advertisers), pick your target countries and ideal customer, and set a daily spending limit.

From then on, every day the Engine:

1. **Researches** your market, trends and competitors' ads. It sends out sub-agents that browse in parallel, and you can watch their browser sessions live.
2. **Proposes** new creative ideas grounded in what it found, with sources.
3. **Produces** the approved ideas by briefing Composer, reviewing the cut, asking for fixes, and exporting the MP4.
4. **Reports** back in a daily **Catch Up**, emailed to your team: findings, trends, the videos it made, and next steps.

You can message the Engine mid-run, give it standing instructions ("keep videos under 30s, never show competitor logos"), and build up a shared asset library it reuses. It stops for the day when it reaches your budget.

**Explore** shows you what works, **Composer** makes it yours, and **Engines** do both on their own every day.

Prefer to work from your own AI assistant? Latted also connects to Claude, ChatGPT and Codex over **MCP**, so it can make videos from wherever you already work.

## **Who it's for**

* **Founders and small teams** with a great product and no marketing team, who want a steady stream of video ads without hiring an agency.
* **Creative and growth teams** at games, apps, DTC brands and software companies who want more variations of their winning ads (localizations, character swaps, new hooks) and want them faster.

## **Our ask**

1. **Try it**: run a search in Explore for your own brand or a competitor at [latted.com](http://latted.com), and make your first video in Composer.
2. **Spin up an Engine** for your startup and tell us what it gets right and wrong in your first Catch Up.
3. **Intros**: if you know a growth or creative lead running many Meta or TikTok ads, we'd love an intro. Reach us at \[[founders@latted.com](mailto:founders@latted.com)\].
4. Follow along on [X](https://claude.ai/epitaxy/local_5bad3062-1491-48f1-a248-874f8fb60726#) and [Instagram (@lattedcom)](https://instagram.com/lattedcom).

Thanks for reading, and we can't wait to see what you make!
